fields.label: Account Code
fields.description: The code trial balances post to: main_account in every upload, main_account_id in the warehouse. It is the join key, so it cannot be renamed.

fields.label: Chart of Accounts
fields.description: The group chart this account belongs to, e.g. GROUP_GAAP. A chart file holds one chart.

fields.label: Parent Account
fields.description: The heading this account sits under. It must be a heading (Is Group) in the same chart.

fields.label: Is Group
fields.description: A heading: it has accounts under it and is never posted to.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only a Published account is in the group chart: trial balances may post to it, and it is written to the warehouse. Inactive withdraws it. Publishing needs the Close Lead (EPM Admin).

fields.label: Account Type
fields.options:
Asset
Liability
Equity
Revenue
Expense
Balance sheet
Profit and loss
fields.description: Required to publish an account that is not a heading.

fields.label: Statement Section
fields.description: Asset, Liability, Equity and Balance sheet belong on the Balance Sheet; Revenue, Expense and Profit and loss on the Profit and Loss. An account under a heading is on the heading's statement.

fields.label: Normal Balance
fields.description: Left blank, it follows the account type.

fields.label: Time Balance
fields.description: flow: a Profit and Loss movement over the period. balance: a Balance Sheet position at its end. Left blank, it follows the statement.

fields.label: Translation Method
fields.description: The rate consolidation translates this account at (IAS 21). Left blank: historical for Equity, closing for the Balance Sheet, average for the Profit and Loss. A Profit and Loss account may be declared closing (hyperinflation, IAS 29); it can never be historical, and a Balance Sheet account never average. Changing it on a Published account re-translates every period, closed ones included, at the next full rebuild.

fields.label: Is Posting
fields.description: Trial balances may post to it. A heading never is.

fields.label: Allow Intercompany
fields.description: It may carry intercompany partner rows. The pairing lives in Intercompany Account.

fields.label: Main Account Category
fields.description: The budget permission key (Main Account Category).

fields.label: Cash Flow
fields.description: Not read yet: the cash flow statement still reads Cash Flow Category (konsol#182, PR5).

fields.label: Retained Earnings Account
fields.description: The one equity account each year's result is closed to. Exactly one Published account per chart carries it. Period-end-balance trial balances need it: the warehouse posts the year-end close into it in the fiscal calendar's Closing period.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Manual: entered here. Upload: loaded from a chart file (the Main Account list's Upload chart).
